notes: Both use matched source pairing, original chirp preparation, raw waveform MSE/spectral, fixed-reader CE, clean identity and approved accepted pseudo CE. Raw network and default E104 head unchanged.

A frozen normalized clean E104 L_s embedding centroid per lawful visible TX gives the negative prototype bank. For each labeled clean packet embedding c, choose the highest-cosine wrong prototype p. Recover normalized embedding z, clean gap m=max(1-c dot p,1e-4), positive error e=-(z-c) dot c. The control loss is mean log1p(ReLU(e)/m). The candidate changes only e to e+(z-c) dot p. Both multiply this extra term by 0.35 and only gradients to z via recovered L_s are allowed.

No new feature-bank loss on U_s. Prototypes, clean counterparts and the nearest false class are kept separate from model updates. This is training geometry only; no new classifier, prototype or auxiliary input during inference.
